scope: Same-day focused update: source-linked final-budget predictions and independent metric reconstruction.
inclusion_criteria: Primary studies directly relevant to numerical verification or evaluation reliability; official documentation for implemented mathematics and software
Recent discovery window 2022-01-01 through 2026-10-20; earlier retained references remain separately attributed
exclusion_criteria: Unrelated laboratory workflows or measurement domains
No extension to new biological models or claimed prospective validation

searches.query_translation: ("reproducibility"[Title/Abstract] OR "data leakage"[Title/Abstract]) AND "protein"[Title/Abstract] AND "benchmark*"[Title/Abstract] AND 2022/01/01:2026/10/20[Date - Publication]
searches.limits: Only first 6 relevance-ranked records of 130 screened; no next-page retrieval.
